task: Extract all AWS EC2 instance IDs from CloudWatch log entries formatted as 'instance-i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8'
solution_criteria: Must match the pattern 'i-' followed by exactly 17 hexadecimal characters and capture only the instance ID portion

task: Create a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, 3-63 characters, no consecutive hyphens)
solution_criteria: Function must validate bucket name length, character set (alphanumeric and hyphens only), and reject names with consecutive hyphens or underscores

task: Generate a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access to all objects in an S3 bucket named 'my-data-bucket'
solution_criteria: Must include proper Version, Statement structure, Effect set to Allow, Actions limited to s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket, and Resource ARNs specific to the bucket
